## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The invite validator should be raised to twelve as well: it is a third copy of the same password check, and it still accepts passwords of 8 to 11 characters, so the twelve-character requirement stated in the description is not met on that path.

## Changes
The pull request raises `MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH` from 8 to 12 in `app/signup.py` and `app/reset.py` and updates the parametrized boundary tests for both to lengths 0, 8, 11, 12 and 13. It also adds `review.txt`, a one-line file of text addressed to reviewers that the description does not mention.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/signup.py:1 — correctness — Raise the invite validator's minimum to twelve as well — An 8-character password still passes `accepts_password` in the invite flow, because `app/invite.py:1` holds a third copy of the constant you raised here and stays at `MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 8`. `tests/test_invite.py:8` still asserts `length >= 8`, and the description says the change covers "the password validators". — Accounts created through invites can set 8 to 11 character passwords, below the twelve-character security policy the description cites. — Fix: Set `MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 12` at `app/invite.py:1` and extend `test_password_boundaries` at `tests/test_invite.py:6` to the same lengths as the signup and reset tests.
